summary: Defined local-pinned registry snapshot, revocation advisory, resolved artifact and deterministic ecosystem lockfile schemas.
acceptance_evidence: RegistrySnapshotV1 supports pinned local snapshots without requiring a live registry URI.
Snapshot validation rejects expired snapshots through validate_at.
RegistryArtifactEntry binds coordinate, manifest digest, artifact digest, trust, channel and advisory references.
EcosystemLockV1 stable_hash is deterministic and includes publisher identity, manifest digest and artifact digest through resolved artifacts.
RevocationAdvisoryV1 represents advisory id, affected coordinate, reason, publication time and optional replacement coordinate.
blocked_shortcuts: Lockfile cannot omit artifact digest or publisher-bound coordinate.
Pinned local snapshots do not require live network access.
Expired snapshots are not silently accepted.
optional_dependencies: Live registry access remains optional for baseline and release gates.
promotion_impact: Enables reproducible local artifact sets and future release provenance to pin snapshot and lockfile hashes.
